title: 35-min tutorial: Claude Code as a full video editor - OpenArt MCP (Seedance 2.5) generates talking-head/B-roll, HyperFrames renders graphics, ElevenLabs makes SFX/music, here.now is the comment-on-timeline review loop; also announces Meta's official Meta Ads MCP

tools.name: OpenArt (sponsor) + OpenArt MCP
tools.detail: openart.ai/mcp URL added as a Connector in Claude desktop (Customize > Connectors); hosts Seedance 2.5; video editing (hat swap, Spanish dub) only in the web UI, not via MCP

tools.name: Seedance 2.5 (ByteDance)
tools.detail: 30s generation, up to 50 multimodal references, region-level editing, native audio sync

tools.name: HyperFrames
tools.detail: GitHub repo pasted into Claude Code: 'get this set up'; enables Claude to render motion graphics/edits

tools.name: here.now
tools.detail: frame.io-style review canvas with timeline comments and beat map; 'Connect Agent' button gives a prompt to paste into Claude Code; free plan

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.detail: Developers > API keys; key pasted into Claude Code for SFX, background music, voice

tools.name: Meta Ads MCP (official)
tools.detail: set up in Meta developer dashboard; build campaigns, ad sets, audiences, catalogs, pull spend reports; 'went live July 16'

tools.name: Claude Code (Fable 5, Ultra Code / max effort)
tools.detail: Max plan; ran 6 parallel agents for style analysis

claims: A 30s AI talking-head of the creator rendered in ~10 minutes and was near-flawless (one vocal-fry artifact)
V2 of the edit ran ~8 minutes and used only ~53,000 tokens because the model orchestrates tools rather than writing code
Took 4 versions (V1-V4) of feedback via here.now comments to reach 'no notes'
Seedance 2.5 mispronounces names in long scripts; fix by instructing Claude to write scripts phonetically
For a clean clone, give the reference video and change only one thing (the dialogue); long prompts changed the whole scene
Meta released an official MCP server for Meta Ads (live July 16)
how_to_steps: Add OpenArt MCP: copy URL from openart.ai/mcp, Claude desktop > Customize > Connectors > add, log in
Generate test clips at 480p / 4s first, then scale to 30s / higher quality
Give Claude a file path to your reference talking-head video; ask for a script, approve it, then generate the 30s video
Ask Claude to propose 3-5 motion-graphic overlays and generate them
Install HyperFrames (paste GitHub URL), connect here.now via its Connect Agent prompt, paste ElevenLabs API key

Give Claude an Instagram reel URL as the editing style reference; ask it to analyze frame-by-frame, generate visuals for every line, add SFX + music via ElevenLabs, and publish V1 to a here.now canvas
Leave timestamped comments on the canvas; tell Claude 'apply those edits and give me V2'; repeat; demand a QA pass comparing notes
Keep an 'internal automations' folder with one folder per video project (captions, QA screenshots, assets, audio, scripts, music variations, SFX)
Once it works, save the workflow as a skill and rerun on a cheaper model (Opus 5, no Ultra Code)

relevance.why: If Haji does founder-led video marketing, this is the most complete agentic editing pipeline seen; the review-canvas feedback loop and project-folder discipline are reusable. Heavy time investment though.

implement_score.why: Several accounts/keys (OpenArt credits, ElevenLabs, here.now) and a long first setup; worth a half-day trial only if short-form video is a growth channel. The Meta Ads MCP is worth checking separately if running paid ads.
